sections.heading: Data Collection
sections.content:
This app does not collect, store, or transmit any personal user data to external servers.

All data is stored locally on your device:
- Your reading progress
- Your bookmarks
- Your theme and language preferences
- Your reading speed settings

None of this data leaves your device.

sections.heading: Permissions
sections.content:
The app requests minimal permissions:
- Internet: For loading chapter data on first use
- Local Storage: For saving your progress and preferences

No camera, microphone, or location access is required or used.

sections.heading: Third-Party Services
sections.content:
This app does not use:
- Analytics or tracking
- Advertisements
- Social media integration
- Cloud sync services

Your data stays private and offline.
